title: Megurine Luka — A New Member Arrives♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for lending me an ear, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It was my pleasure.
Feel free to come visit any time♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will. See you later then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't worry, you'll find your answer.
After all, you're not alone, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, I should get back to setting up for the show... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin? You look upset. Is there something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, well... Actually, I overheard your conversation with Shizuku just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And, you know... I'm worried about her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. If you go around looking so upset, your fans are going to worry about you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know... But still...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if it's my fault that Shizuku is having so much trouble right now...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I get the impression there's a specific reason behind your worrying, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well... Airi came to visit me before, and she was saying that she needed something called an agency in order to be an idol.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I said I was sure she and the others would be able to give others hope regardless of how they did it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I told her that they didn't need to be in an agency to do that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And now it looks like that's the reason they've decided to become idols on their own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But after seeing Shizuku like that, I'm not so sure it was a good idea to say those things...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure the fans would be happier and more supportive if I kept being the idol they expect to see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Back then, I was happy knowing that I was living up to their expectations.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I can't do that on my own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't think I should've said those things.
Now, because of me, Shizuku is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're such a kind person, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But think about what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you think those girls are so irresponsible that they'd do something just because somebody told them to?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, of course not!
They're all serious about becoming idols.
They want to inspire hope in others!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Good, I'm glad we agree.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So don't worry. I'm sure they put a lot of thought into the path they've chosen.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Besides, I don't think what Shizuku is worried about right now has anything to do with their decision about not joining an agency.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? Really...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I think Shizuku is worried about is how she can meet the expectations her fans have of her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's trying to decide whether or not to continue playing the version of her that was created by others...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think she would have eventually had to deal with the same question even if she had joined an agency.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
I think I understand what you're trying to say!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still... This is going to be tough on Shizuku regardless of which path ends up choosing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's true. But I'm sure by persisting, she'll be able to find the answer she's looking for.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe she's strong enough to get through this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm also very much looking forward to seeing what she finds at the end of this journey.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you think it'll be?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure whatever it is, we'll all be dazzled...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I get the feeling it will give her the ability to fill people's hearts with hope♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hope she finds it soon!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I do too. We'll just have to wait until she does.
